articles.summary:

articles.title: New ArcticRAT Malware Uses Fake VPN Connections to Evade Google Play Protect During Installation
articles.summary:
ArcticRAT, an Android remote access trojan (RAT). It started as spyware aimed at users of 11 cryptocurrency apps and has grown into a modular, AI-assisted tool for full device takeover. The most notable change is that its operators now send stolen SMS and app data to a large language model (LLM) for automated financial triage. […]

articles.title: AWS Warns of MCP Gateway Registry Vulnerability Allowing Attackers to Access Internal Network Services
articles.summary:
AWS has disclosed a server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw in mcp-gateway-registry, an open-source registry and gateway for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-125926 under bulletin 2026-180-AWS, the issue lets an authenticated user make the gateway send requests to services on a deployment’s internal network.
